verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Plaid Auth returning account and routing numbers so a developer can initiate ACH debits, and a European Payments suite for one-off real-time payments. Nothing in the pack documents variable recurring payments, standing consents, or a recurring debit or schedule flow. Auth is a building block for one-off debits, not a documented recurring-payment capability, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As a developer, recurring bank payments are supported — variable recurring payments, standing consents, or documented recurring debit flows built on the connection
